'''''Koh-Lanta: Le Retour des Héros''''' is the first special season of ''[[Koh-Lanta]]'' and the ninth season overall. It was broadcast on TF1 from January 13 to February 13, 2009.

[[Romuald Lafite]] defeated [[Jade Handi]] in a 5-2 [[jury]] vote to become the [[Sole Survivor]].
==Twists/Changes==
*'''Shortened Game:''' Compared to all previous seasons which ran for between 39-43 days, this season ran for only 21 days.
*'''Fewer Contestants:''' All previous seasons featured 16 castaways to begin with. This season started with only 14 castaways.
*'''[[Returning Players/Koh-Lanta|Returning Players]]:''' All the castaways had competed on a previous season.
*'''Sudden Death Challenge:''' On Day 1, a challenge occurred where the last two mixed-gendered pairs to finish [[Blind Leading the Blind|its first portion]] would subsequently compete in a footrace to stay in the game. The last man and woman to finish this footrace would be automatically eliminated.
*'''New [[Tribe]] Member:''' At the first [[Reward Challenge]] on Day 4, the winning tribe would be given the opportunity to chose one of the eliminated castaways at the Day 1 challenge to join their tribe. By a 3-2 vote, [[Jean-Bernard Hauton-Arnaud]]  returned to the game and joined Tupan.
* '''[[Ambassadors]] Elimination:''' At this season's summit, instead of agreeing on a castaway to receive an extra vote at the first post-[[merge]] [[Tribal Council]], the ambassadors must unanimously agree to eliminate one castaway from the game. If they fail to come to a consensus, one of the ambassadors would be eliminated in a rock draw.

==Trivia==
* Many former ''Koh-Lanta'' castaways were present for the live reunion and final tally. They were seen celebrating onstage following Romuald's victory.
* ''Le Retour des Héros'' is the fourth consecutive season of ''Koh-Lanta'' whose final five all belonged to the same starting tribe, following ''[[Koh-Lanta: Vanuatu|Vanuatu]]'', ''[[Koh-Lanta: Palawan|Palawan]]'' and ''[[Koh-Lanta: Caramoan|Caramoan]]''.
* This is the most-watched season of ''Koh-Lanta'', averaging 8,288,000 viewers per episode (33.75% of French television viewers) and peaking at 9,169,000 viewers during the finale (39.3% of French television viewers).
* This season featured at least one castaway from every previous season of ''Koh-Lanta''. The highest number of returnees (3 in total) are from ''[[Koh-Lanta: Panama|Panama]]''.
